justification: Inspected `src/main/java/org/apache/commons/io/output/ProxyOutputStream.java` (287 lines). The class is a focused `OutputStream` proxy: 2 constructors, a nested `Builder`, 2 hook methods (`beforeWrite`, `afterWrite`), delegate operations (`close`, `flush`, 3 `write` overloads), 3 thin `writeRepeat` overloads, and small helper methods (`handleIOException`, `setReference`, `unwrap`). These members all serve one cohesive responsibility: delegating to and decorating a single underlying stream. `src/test/java/org/apache/commons/io/output/ProxyOutputStreamTest.java` confirms the same proxy-oriented behavior, and related subclasses (`CountingOutputStream.java`, `CloseShieldOutputStream.java`, `TaggedOutputStream.java`, `TeeOutputStream.java`) each extend it for one specific concern rather than indicating the base class itself is poorly decomposed.
